testimonial.name: Manvi Agarwal
testimonial.title: We iterated and shipped 10x faster with Superflow!
testimonial.subText: Superflow transformed Writesonic's marketing strategy, slashing our monthly expenses by $5,000 and tripling the speed of our campaign rollouts. Their assistance was crucial in greatly enhancing our website design and streamlining our content review.

faq.question: Is Superflow any good?
faq.answer: Annotation tools enable users to add comments, suggestions, and feedback directly on digital content, such as website projects, allowing for interactive collaboration, faster decision-making, and simplified reviewing, brainstorming, and sharing of insights through intuitive click-and-type interactions.
